about: scripts/homologues.py align --usalign at 55e1a78: foldmap's structure route (align_chains, match 'structure') against US-align 20241108 (`USalign A.pdb B.pdb -mol prot -mm 0 -ter 2`) on the same residues (each chain's Cα as foldmap reads it, --assembly asu). TM-scores normalised by A's chain (US-align: by Structure_1, A; d0 of A's length, as foldmap's). US-align's pairs: every column of its alignment holding a residue of both. Limits where US-align's TM >= 0.5: foldmap's TM within 0.05, and >= 85% of US-align's pairs reproduced within ±1 residue (13a-3).
